analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 trading days maintained a wait-and-see stance. RSI declined from 60.9 to 53.4, continuing consolidation within the neutral zone. MACD histogram worsened from 3.3854 to 0.6638, confirming weakening upward momentum. Trading volume also contracted to 0.65 relative to the 5-day average, indicating a lack of direction. The current price of $178.94 is above SMA20 ($171.49) and SMA50 ($163.74) but below SMA200 ($192.35), suggesting downward pressure on the medium-to-long-term trend. Weekly RSI at 49.6 has entered a weak zone. ADX at 28.2 indicates a clear trend, but the slight upward bias (+DI 28.3 vs -DI 13.8) is weak. The current price of $178.94 is 21.6% above the 52-week low of $139.11 and 58.4% below the 52-week high of $402.16, positioning it near the lower end of its 52-week range (15.1% from the low). Volume at 0.65x the 5-day average is subdued. The price is consolidating between the swing support at $177.62 and resistance at $181.49. No clear buy or sell signals met, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
